# `Dep`

**Kind:** class

**Source:** `src/graphrefly/_facade.py:471`

## Signature

```python
Dep(dep: _k.Dep)
```

## Description

One dependency as an invocation sees it, ``ctx.deps[i]`` (R-invocation).

``id`` is the dependency's name. ``waves`` are the arrays it delivered to this
invocation, each as its DATA values in order (a RESOLVED array is ``[]``);
``terminal`` is its COMPLETE or ERROR of this invocation, or ``None``; ``has`` says
whether a value was received and not invalidated, and ``value`` is the latest one,
or ``graphrefly.SENTINEL`` without one (``None`` is valid DATA); ``invalidated`` says
whether an INVALIDATE arrived on it, under the manual INVALIDATE policy.

## Attributes

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `str` | Return the dependency's name. |
| `waves` | `list[list[object]]` | Return this invocation's arrays from the dependency, as their DATA values. |
| `terminal` | `ControlMessage | ErrorMessage | None` | Return the dependency's COMPLETE or ERROR of this invocation, or ``None``. |
| `has` | `bool` | Return whether a value was received from the dependency and not invalidated. |
| `value` | `object` | Return the latest value received, or ``graphrefly.SENTINEL`` without one. |
| `invalidated` | `bool` | Return whether an INVALIDATE arrived on this input (manual policy only). |
